What will underpin the next generation of AI beyond pure scaling? And what does 🇪🇺 Europe need to do to help shape that frontier?

Our CEO Arthur Mensch joined a panel at the Digital Summit in Berlin alongside Tanja Rueckert (Bosch), Robin Rombach (Black Forest Labs) and Prof. Dr. Bernhard Schölkopf (Max Planck Institute / ELLIS Tübingen), moderated by Mads Pankow , to debate these questions and push Europe to move faster.

"Sovereignty, and ultimately freedom, is based on the ability to solve one's own problems oneself."
Chancellor Friedrich Merz said this in his keynote at the summit, held under the theme "Shaping AI: safe, sovereign, competitive."

Mistral was happy to be part of the summit, as both a speaker and an exhibitor, and to stand alongside French Digital Minister Anne Le Hénanff 

Our message was clear: 🇩🇪 Germany and 🇪🇺 Europe have enormous potential, particularly when it comes to Industrial AI. But Europe must compete at the frontier. Only then can it achieve true sovereignty in AI.

Compute is what turns European capability into global leadership. 

Mistral Large 4 was trained on just 4,000 GPUs. Imagine what's possible with more.

Thank you to Digital Minister Karsten Wildberger and State Secretary Markus Richter for having us in Berlin.
